text: DSH Plugin Compare 是面向 DSH Web 的插件与 Agent 预设比较工具。它在 Web 会话界面加入 Compare 操作，并通过 Host RPC 读取历史 Session 或启动受控 A/B 运行。用户可以比较两个已有会话，也可以在同一模型和提示词下分别运行两个预设；报告整理执行时间、Token、步骤、工具调用、重试、显式成功检查和文件变化证据。受控比较支持多组配对试验并提供统计摘要，也可导出 JSON、HTML、SVG 等报告。适合需要检查不同插件或预设表现的 DSH 用户；受控运行需选择已配置的模型提供商。

DSH Plugin Compare adds a panel to DSH Web for comparing saved sessions or running two presets with the same prompt and model. Reports show time, tokens, tool activity, checks, and file evidence. Repeat runs and export JSON, HTML, or SVG reports. Controlled runs need a configured model provider.

想查看两次运行在 Token、耗时和工具调用上的差别。
让 DSH 展示 Agent 执行过程的时间线和文件改动证据。
我需要重复跑几组基准，看看结果波动有多大。
想给两种预设运行相同的验收命令并对照结果。
I want to compare the token use and duration of two DSH sessions.
How can I run the same prompt with two agent presets and inspect the outcomes?
DSH Plugin Compare 的功能「比较历史会话」：从 Compare 面板选择两个不同的已保存 Session，读取运行事件并生成并排指标和时间线证据。
DSH Plugin Compare 的功能「受控预设对比」：选择工作区、提示词、模型和两个 Agent 预设后，分别运行基线与候选版本并比较运行结果。
DSH Plugin Compare 的功能「导出比较报告」：将比较指标、检查结果和运行证据整理成可分享的 JSON、HTML 或 SVG 报告。

dsh-plugin-compare README · DSH Plugin Compare：> Compare the runs. Inspect the evidence.

`dsh-plugin-compare` compares DeepSeek Harness plugins and presets using existing sessions or controlled A/B runs. It turns recorded execution evidence into side-by-side timelines, measurable deltas, explicit success checks, and shareable comparison reports.

[](./example/results/checkout-demo.html)

中文文档: [README.zh.md](./README.zh.md)

dsh-plugin-compare README · Installation：Requires Node.js 22.19+ and a DSH Web profile. Install the stable release from npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-compare
dsh web
```

The `next` channel is reserved for explicitly announced prereleases. Opt in only when testing one:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-compare@next
```

Update or remove the installed package with the same profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-plugin-compare
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-compare
```

dsh-plugin-compare README · Installation：After installing, updating, or removing the plugin, stop any running Web Host with `Ctrl+C` and start `dsh web` again. The Compare panel is then available in DSH Web.

dsh-plugin-compare README · Try the checkout example：Follow the [step-by-step walkthrough (Chinese)](./example/README.md): create a fresh intentionally broken checkout project, compare Standard and `dsh-expert-mode`, inspect the checks, and save screenshots and reports. A reviewed real-run [HTML report](./example/results/checkout-demo.html) and [screenshots](./example/screenshots/README.md) are included. The fixture needs no third-party dependencies; model-backed runs still consume tokens. Run `node example/prepare.mjs` from this repository to prepare a fresh workspace without changing the fixture.

dsh-plugin-compare README · Status：Stable 0.1.x. The Web `Compare` panel can compare two existing sessions or run a controlled baseline/candidate pair. Controlled runs explicitly select one configured provider/model for both variants, copy the source workspace twice, compose the selected agent preset in each copy, submit the same prompt, optionally execute the same success-check command, and capture runtime Git evidence. Reports include synchronized timelines, persisted file diffs, explicit check outcomes, and redacted JSON, self-contained HTML, SVG, or PNG exports. See [the roadmap](./docs/ROADMAP.md).

dsh-plugin-compare README · Status：Historical sessions only expose `write` / `edit` diffs persisted in the canonical log. Runtime Git status and tracked diffs are available only for controlled runs, where they are captured before the temporary copies are removed.

dsh-plugin-compare README · Status：The controlled runner supports 1–10 paired trials and alternates which variant runs first. It reports explicit-check counts plus mean and median paired deltas for time and tokens; a Student-t 95% interval is shown when at least two pairs exist. Raw paired observations and Session ids remain in JSON exports so the summary can be recomputed. These intervals describe observed variation under a small-sample assumption—they do not establish an automatic winner or a causal conclusion. Dependency directories are excluded from copies, external symlinks are refused, and Git worktree pointer files are not copied back into the experiment.

dsh-plugin-compare README · Status：The selected provider/model is passed explicitly to every controlled Agent. If an Agent fails before completing its task, the structured failure is displayed and exported, the success-check command is marked `not-run`, and the comparison is labeled invalid rather than turning unchanged-code test failures into a preset result.

dsh-plugin-compare README · Privacy before sharing：Exports can contain prompts, source paths, code diffs, command output, provider/model names, and Session ids. Automatic redaction is best-effort and is **not** a privacy clearance. Review every HTML, JSON, SVG, PNG, and screenshot before sharing it; remove credentials, account information, private URLs, personal paths, and proprietary source as appropriate. A redaction count of zero means only that no configured pattern matched.

dsh-plugin-compare README · Evidence captured：- Task outcome and explicit test result
- Tokens, time, steps, retries, and tool failures
- Explicit test results and controlled-run Git snapshots
- Repeat trials and uncertainty display

dsh-plugin-compare README · Development：Contributor requirements: Node.js 22.19+ and pnpm 11.19.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm verify
```

Install a local checkout into DSH Web:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-compare
dsh web
```

The repository targets DSH `0.1.1-rc.2` or newer compatible `0.1.x` builds. DeepSeek Harness is still in developer preview, so every release must be tested against the current published build.

dsh-plugin-compare README · Development：CI tests both the minimum supported DSH version and the dynamic npm `latest` tag through a real plugin-install and Web-Host boot smoke test. See [Compatibility](./docs/COMPATIBILITY.md).

dsh-plugin-compare README · Architecture：The package keeps deterministic comparison logic in `src/core`, DSH Host integration in `src/index.ts`, and the browser bundle in `src/client`. See [ARCHITECTURE.md](./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).
